name: Lush Arcade
description: Original Newb-style color and lighting treatment adapted for a 2D arcade frame.
notes: The scene input is sampled as sRGB and converted to linear light before bloom and grading.
Use linear filtering for the scene upscale when smooth scaling is selected.
Keep the original 4:3 game viewport; any 16:9 layout must add side areas rather than stretch the game image.
This is a post-process preset. It does not create geometry-based shadows, reflections, moving foliage, clouds or water.
